mintAuthority.summary: Frankencoin remains economically unbounded, but every new arbitrary issuer faces an unavoidable 14-day public window and a 200-bps holding-period-weighted FPS veto. The closed pinned native caller inventory proves collateral/limit-gated issuance, atomically repaid flash minting and D30-S formula-bound, hard-rate-capped interest with minority-replaceable seven-day rate changes. Distressed Equity restructuring is asymmetric, but the pin's healthy equity makes it unreachable; D30-R conditionally excludes the dependent zero-supply bootstrap. All D30/Amendments A–B gates are positively certified at the pin, including these owner-ruled monetary-policy and insolvency exceptions; bridge routes remain a separate lane. At the v10.05 campaign pin, the largest account-level aged-vote controller has 1008–1009 bps (floor / conservative ceiling); the 2-of-3 MultiSigWalletV3 clone owns its direct FPS votes. Concentration is diagnostic, not an affirmative admission threshold; no new H classification is claimed.
